what: The DISSONANCE set: the wrong jersey, however it got there — trades, twilight signings, one-game cameos. Hand-picked from the Weird Jersey List.
rule: The stat line is the STINT'S — that team's rows only. The skill (Speed+Power, trust) is the player's season-wide evidence: a one-game Hawk is still the 2004 Rasheed Wallace.

Michael Jordan.note: the twilight signing the whole set is named for — 38 years old, two seasons in Washington after retiring a Bull. 2002 over 2003 because it is the better of the two (BPM 3.1 against 1.7, PER 20.7 against 19.3); the WAS97 mark covers 1997-2011, so the card wears the Wizards logo he actually played in.

Vince Carter.note: 34 games in Phoenix between Orlando and Dallas
age 43, the fourth decade, the last shot

Paul Pierce.note: the Truth as a Clipper reserve

Joe Johnson.note: seven-time All-Star, 23 games off Houston's bench

Rajon Rondo.note: the last stop, in wine and gold

Isaiah Thomas.note: 17 Lakers games after the Cleveland trade

Russell Westbrook.note: the user's pick for the Dissonance completion reward (2026-09-06): one season as a Rocket beside Harden, 57 games at 27.2 ppg, a pairing with no card anywhere
